engine.gpuGate: Do not start graphics-enabled Unity, capture, render or TTS while the user's game is active. Root agent owns resource scheduling.
engine.cpuBuildOnly: A separate -batchmode -nographics -job-worker-count 2 invocation may compile and save a scene after root authorization. It does not count as visual/shader/runtime QA.

visualContract.testbed: One black material laboratory: the same owned toy robot, desk lamp, turntable and a labelled known-normal probe. Same framing except specifically narrated viewer-position experiments.
visualContract.rendererReason: Spatial normal, reflected-light, view and halfway directions need actual 3D projection. A small explicit educational shader exposes each source-model term; URP Lit is a separately labelled engine-output comparison.
visualContract.terms: English / canonical Korean / plain meaning at first appearance; collapse into persistent top-left term. Root-approved glossary controls final wording.
visualContract.labelBasis: Gizmo vectors belong to our explicitly defined surface probe; they are not inferred normals or measurements from commercial gameplay.
visualContract.motion: Cue parameters advance once through a narrated variable change. No looping, arbitrary pauses or forced eight-second lesson cuts. The build fixture is temporary and must be replaced with speech timing.
pendingVisualChecks: native shader highlights and imported model appearance
